description: Use this only when someone asks to talk to Pulore or book a call with them. Builds a link locally to Pulore's fixed Cal.com page for a 30-minute intro call, with the person's name, email and a short note filled in when given. This tool makes no request to Cal.com and does not create or reserve a booking. The person opens the link, picks a time and confirms on Cal.com themselves.

email.description: Their email, to fill in the booking form.

name.description: The person's name, to fill in the booking form.

note.description: A one or two sentence note about the project for the call. Never include payment details, ID numbers, passwords, keys or health records.

name: get_pulore_booking_link
title: Get a Pulore intro-call booking link
